The issuer appears investment-grade but not high-grade: leverage is fairly elevated (liabilities ≈74% of assets), liquidity is a bit weak (current ratio 0.91), and EBIT relative to the very large asset base is modest, though positive profitability and substantial retained earnings/equity support credit quality. On balance, this looks most consistent with a mid-BBB profile rather than a stronger A-category issuer.

DECISION: BBB
